The '''Te Hasa system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]] region within the [[Veragi sector/Legends|Veragi sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained [[Te Hasa/Legends|Te Hasa]], a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was home to 10,000 members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that had settled the planet [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TGE" />

The Te Hasa system was connected to the world of [[Malanose]] via a relatively poorly-known [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. The [[Rokak'k Baran]], a massive [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] equipped with a Class 3 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] that was the main method of travel within the Gree Enclave, took two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] to travel the route and made regular, two-day-long visits to Te Hasa.<ref name="TGE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Te Hasa system was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square K-2.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
